spanish: las colgaduras del atrio, sus columnas y sus basas, y la cortina de la puerta del atrio,

units.es: y la cortina de la puerta del atrio

grammarChanges: Translated untranslated Hebrew transliteration 'masaj' (מָסַךְ, H4539) into Spanish as 'cortina'.
Added the definite article to 'puerta' ('de puerta' -> 'de la puerta') because שַׁעַר is definite inside the construct chain closed by הֶחָצֵר.
